name: AIOStreams
description: AIOStreams consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services into a single, highly customisable super-addon, with filtering, sorting, and formatting of results.

notes.text: No authentication is enabled by default. Set AIOSTREAMS_AUTH in /opt/aiostreams_data/.env to secure the dashboard.
Keep SECRET_KEY in /opt/aiostreams_data/.env: changing it after the first run invalidates all saved encrypted configs. Back up the .env file.
The FUSE share (Shares > FUSE) needs /dev/fuse: set var_fuse=yes or enable FUSE in the advanced install before creating the container. WebDAV and NFS shares work without it.
